parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Specifies the refresh time in seconds for polling updates from the Mill cloud service. The account is limited to 2500 requests per hour in total, and each cycle costs roughly one request per house plus one per room

parameter.name: macAddress
parameter.label: MAC Address
parameter.description: Either MAC address or heaterId is required

parameter.name: heaterId
parameter.label: Heater ID
parameter.description: Device UUID as issued by the Mill cloud API. Use auto discovery to find this value; numeric IDs from older configurations are not valid

parameter.name: power
parameter.label: Heating Power
parameter.description: No longer used. The Mill cloud API reports measured power directly, so the Energy Usage channel no longer needs a nominal value

parameter.name: roomId
parameter.label: Room ID
parameter.description: Room UUID as issued by the Mill cloud API. Use auto discovery to find this value; numeric IDs from older configurations are not valid

parameter.name: homeId
parameter.label: Home ID
parameter.description: House UUID as issued by the Mill cloud API. Use auto discovery to find this value; numeric IDs from older configurations are not valid
